system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: constructs the SubAgent's input by injecting the file's diff, the resolved rule, the list of other changed files, and any user-provided background information into a prompt template
system_prompt_style.note: Rule text resolved per file from four-tier chain; could be argued dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context
env_context_strategy.note: Diff and changed-file list injected up front (paper Sec. 3.2.3) plus tool-driven navigation (file_read, file_find, code_search).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: at80%, a synchronous compression forcibly summarizes the middle region of the conversation history into a structured summary while preserving the system prompt and the most recent interactions
context_compaction.note: MemoryCompressionTask in internal/scan/agent.go; tool outputs bounded (Max 500 lines per call, paper Table 2).

observation_format.evidence_quote: the tool's output is returned as an observation and appended to the conversa-tion history
observation_format.note: Conversion code not in bundle; all tools are text-returning.

tool_call_format.note: Tool definitions passed to LLM client as tool defs; parser not in bundle.

tool_count.evidence_quote: provides a fixed set of six review-specific tools, each with a bounded output
tool_count.note: file_read, file_find, code_search, file_read_diff, code_comment, task_done; tools.json content not in bundle; MCP tools excluded.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: code_commentSubmit a review comment Parsed and collected asynchronously
edit_primitive.note: Tool set (Table 2) has no file-editing tool; review-only agent.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: // Package toolsconfig loads tool definitions from JSON config files.
tool_schema_source.note: Embedded tools.json; MCP server docs: 'extend the review agent with external tools'.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: [MCP Server](https://open-codereview.ai/docs/mcp) — extend the review agent with external tools

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each SubAgent follows a standard ReAct loop [26]
loop_primitives.note: Wrapped in fixed pipeline: dispatch -> per-file ReAct -> relocation -> reflection filter; optional plan/dedup/summary phases.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
// SkipPlan disables the PLAN_TASK pre-pass even when the template
	// defines one.
planning_granularity.note: A PLAN_TASK pre-pass exists; whether its output is stored as a structured object is not visible in bundle; could be implicit.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: dispatches one SubAgent per file in parallel
multi_agent_topology.note: Deterministic (non-LLM) orchestrator dispatches file-level SubAgents; reflector is separate filter.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each SubAgent is then launched as an indepen-dent concurrent task, enabling file-level parallelism.

human_in_loop.note: Confirmation/permission code not in bundle; tools are read-only so gating likely absent but unverified.

short_term_state.note: Session history with task records, comment collector, token counters.

long_term_memory.note: No memory code in bundle; user-global rules are config, not memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
// Resume is an optional read-only checkpoint index from a previous scan
	// session.
state_persistence.note: README: 'ocr review ... --resume <session-id>'; resume is per-file checkpoint granularity.

self_verification.evidence_quote: an external reflector examines each comment against the diff alone under an asymmetric information boundary
self_verification.note: Same LLM, separate call; REVIEW_FILTER_TASK, disabled via --no-filter.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The loop continues until the agent invokestask_done or reaches a maximum iteration bound.
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry seen; LLM transport retries exist (retry report).

rollback.evidence_quote: code_commentSubmit a review comment Parsed and collected asynchronously
rollback.note: Agent makes no file changes (read-only tool set).

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The loop continues until the agent invokestask_done or reaches a maximum iteration bound. We set the default bound to 30
termination_condition.note: MaxTokensBudget stops dispatch (internal/scan/agent.go:71-75); empty-round detection prompts to act or terminate.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
// MaxTokensBudget, when > 0, caps total token usage (input+output, as
	// reported by the API).
cost_controls.note: Cache read/write token tracking in llmloop/loop.go; default budget 0 = unlimited.

timeouts.evidence_quote: // Concurrent task timeout in minutes. 0 means no timeout.
timeouts.note: code_search 10s timeout (paper Table 2); per-subtask timeout, default off.

execution_isolation.note: Runs on host as CLI; no shell tool.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: code_commentSubmit a review comment Parsed and collected asynchronously
filesystem_access.note: Tools only read repo files; relative to host subprocess boundary.

network_policy.note: Tools have no network capability; no network config surface in bundle.

permission_model.evidence_quote: provides a fixed set of six review-specific tools
permission_model.note: Curated fixed tool set rather than per-call authorization.

tracing.evidence_quote: // Package telemetry provides OpenTelemetry-based observability for OpenCodeReview CLI.
tracing.note: Off by default (OCR_ENABLE_TELEMETRY); session JSONL always written.

replayability.evidence_quote: [Session Viewer](https://open-codereview.ai/docs/viewer) — browse and replay review sessions in browser
replayability.note: Viewer replay is display, not re-execution.

eval_hooks.note: No eval runner seen in file tree; AACR-Bench on Hugging Face.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a strict focus rule in the system prompt instructs the SubAgent that findings from other files must not be-come the subject of comments
guardrails.note: Weak fit: file filtering allowlist and reflection filter on outputs could be output_filters.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool.

model_agnostic.note: Own provider abstraction (internal/llm/providers.go), custom providers, Bedrock.

primary_artifact.note: Paper arXiv 2608.09290v2 describes the same system.

stars.note: Date of star count not stated in evidence.
